map.判断反应自发性: Judge whether a reaction is spontaneous
map.输入焓变、熵变与温度，求吉布斯自由能变并判断反应方向。: Enter the enthalpy change, entropy change and temperature to get the Gibbs free energy change and the reaction direction.
map.📖 查看「判断反应自发性 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Judge whether a reaction is spontaneous"
map.ΔG = ΔH − TΔS，单位需一致（kJ）。: ΔG = ΔH - TΔS, with the units consistent in kJ.
map.ΔH=-100, ΔS=0.05, T=298 → ΔG≈-114.9，自发。: ΔH = -100, ΔS = 0.05, T = 298 gives ΔG ≈ -114.9, spontaneous.
map.自发性判定：给定 ΔH、ΔS、T 算 ΔG，ΔG<0 为自发。: Spontaneity check: compute ΔG from ΔH, ΔS and T, where ΔG < 0 means spontaneous.
map.转变温度：算 ΔG=0 的 T=ΔH/ΔS，判断高温或低温自发区间。: Transition temperature: solve ΔG = 0 for T = ΔH/ΔS to see whether the spontaneous range lies at high or low temperature.
map.熵驱动反应识别：ΔH>0 但 ΔS>0 时高温自发（如冰融化）。: Identifying entropy driven reactions: with ΔH > 0 but ΔS > 0 the reaction becomes spontaneous at high temperature, as with ice melting.
map.输入 T=298K，工具输出 ΔG≈−114.9 kJ/mol，判定自发；并提示: Enter T = 298 K and the tool gives ΔG ≈ -114.9 kJ/mol, judged spontaneous, and notes that T = 2000 K is the transition temperature where ΔG = 0.
map.ΔG<0 就一定能发生吗？: Does ΔG < 0 guarantee the reaction happens?
map.只代表热力学自发，速率由动力学决定，可能极慢（如金刚石→石墨）。: It only means thermodynamically spontaneous; the rate is set by kinetics and may be extremely slow, as with diamond turning into graphite.
map.熵单位用 J 还是 kJ？: Should entropy be in J or kJ?
map.ΔH 用 kJ、ΔS 用 J 时 TΔS 差 1000 倍，需统一为同一能量单位: With ΔH in kJ and ΔS in J the TΔS term is off by a factor of 1000, so both must use the same energy unit.
map.标准态和实际情况有差吗？: Do standard and actual conditions differ?
map.实际浓度/分压用 ΔG=ΔG°+RTlnQ 修正，本工具按给定值直接算。: Real concentrations or partial pressures need ΔG = ΔG° + RT ln Q, while this tool computes directly from the values given.
